info.title: Codefactory LangGraph Service
info.description: Private bearer-authenticated management APIs expose validated agent configuration, revisioned declarative agent rosters, and allowlisted workflow checkpoint projections. Raw checkpoint blobs and issue/source payloads are never returned.

200.description: Service and required inference dependency are ready
Current effective configuration and audit metadata
Configuration override saved for new workflow runs
Audited GPU and CPU model selections

post.description: Creates a saved instance configuration using an available shared GGUF filename; it does not provision a Deployment or start a model rollout.

422.description: Instance ID, model filename, or owner login was rejected

get.description: Lists regular GGUF files present in shared inference artifact storage.

delete.description: Deactivates an instance configuration while retaining historical references. Active downloads, active rollouts, and deletion of the final active configuration are rejected.

409.description: Instance has active work or is the last active configuration

post.description: Owner identity is supplied by the authenticated management portal. Enqueues a validated Hugging Face artifact in shared storage; this API never downloads synchronously or changes an inference instance.

409.description: A shared model download is already active

422.description: URL, SHA-256, or model filename was rejected

get.description: Returns durable status and fixed public error text. The submitted URL and SHA-256 are never included in status responses.

post.description: Claims one current, version-matching rollout event with a renewable-by-reclaim lease. Uses the dedicated MODEL_RECONCILER_TOKEN, not the management service token.

503.description: Rollout queue unavailable or reconciler token is not configured

post.description: Acknowledges success or failure for the active lease. Failure details are intentionally not accepted or persisted; same-token retries are idempotent.

409.description: Lease is stale, expired, or already acknowledged differently

get.description: Reads Prometheus-compatible CPU, RAM, NVIDIA GPU utilization, and VRAM samples. Missing and stale data are explicitly labeled.

409.description: Execution has no unresolved no-CI state

reconcilerBearerAuth.description: Dedicated MODEL_RECONCILER_TOKEN shared only with the separately deployed model reconciler.

completion_timeout_seconds.description: Existing local-model request timeout; applies to new workflow runs.

model_filename.description: Owner-selected safe artifact basename from model metadata; never derived from redirect headers.

model_url.description: Credential-free HTTPS Hugging Face model or file URL. The service resolves the exact file's LFS SHA-256; the worker validates redirects and public DNS destinations.
